in_marathi.name: Juhi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Juhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'jwihi', meaning 'fair' or 'radiant'. In Hindu mythology, Juhi is a name of the river Goddess Ganga. It is also believed to represent the radiance of the moon.

in_bengali.name: Juhi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Fair, Radiant
